meta.title: Thinking Highlighter
meta.description: Keyword counts and highlighting for thinking rows: a per-word count chip on the title line (click one to switch that word off; a chip grows and shrinks with its word's size), colouring by word once expanded, per-word tint, text colour, text size (10–22px, the same range DSH's own body text uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, and folded rows counted over the whole chain of thought. The plugin has its own Settings section.
